# own live rc/diagnostic check still decides UNSCORED each run; if a future run of sbl answers one of
# these four cleanly instead, the runner's SCORED count changes but this file does not, and
# inventory_line correctly REFUSES on that mismatch rather than silently accepting a stale declaration
# -- re-measure and edit this file when that happens, per the runner's own header discipline.
